note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 18 November 2026, RealHunt lists 3 homes for sale in Cyprus, each one checked by a person.
In Cyprus, the median asking price of those 3 homes is €350,000 (€4,060 per m², from the 3 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €341,000 and the most expensive €470,000.
Taxes and fees add about 2.5–3.5% to the price of a home in Cyprus (figures as of 2026).
With 3 homes this is a small sample, so the median for Cyprus is a rough guide.

buying.costs_breakdown: Land Registry transfer fees of 3% up to €85,000, 5% to €170,000 and 8% above, halved for resales without VAT (1.5%, 2.5% and 4%); stamp duty abolished from 1 January 2026; lawyer about 1% plus VAT; small Land Registry charges.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: EU citizens buy without restrictions. Non-EU buyers need permission from the Council of Ministers, applied for through the District Officer, and are normally limited to one home or a plot of up to 4,014 m².
buying.annual_property_tax: There is no annual national property tax (abolished in 2017); owners pay municipal fees of about €90 to €300 a year, plus sewerage and local authority charges.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents pay income tax on Cyprus rental income at 20% to 35% after deducting 20% of the gross rent and loan interest, plus a 2.65% health contribution (GHS); the special defence contribution does not apply to them.

homes.title: Ready 2-bed flat steps from the beach in Coral Bay, with pool and sea views
homes.title_es: Piso de 2 dormitorios listo para entrar a pasos de la playa en Coral Bay, con piscina y vistas al mar
homes.summary: A ready-to-move-in 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment a few steps from the Blue Flag beaches of Coral Bay, west of Paphos. 84 m² with a modern fitted kitchen, a bright open living area and a private balcony with sea views for the sunsets. Gated complex with a large communal pool in landscaped gardens and private parking. About 25 km from Paphos airport. At about €4,060/m² it is roughly 18% below the Paphos median asking price (€4,923/m², index.cy, October 2026).

homes.title: Furnished townhouse with a private pool, 100 m from the sea in Protaras
homes.title_es: Adosado amueblado con piscina privada a 100 m del mar en Protaras
homes.summary: A 2009 townhouse 100 metres from the coastline of Protaras, sold fully furnished and ready to live in or rent out. 94 m² on a 155 m² plot with its own swimming pool: open-plan living with a new kitchen and breakfast bar, a renovated shower room downstairs, and two double bedrooms upstairs, the main one with a balcony over the pool. Bars and restaurants are within walking distance. At about €3,720/m² it is roughly 27% below the Protaras median asking price (€5,136/m², index.cy, October 2026).

homes.title: Sea-front ground-floor flat with a 50 m² terrace and overflow pool in Protaras
homes.title_es: Bajo frente al mar con terraza de 50 m² y piscina desbordante en Protaras
homes.summary: A 2020 sea-front ground-floor apartment in Protaras, a stone's throw from Green Bay and Cavo Maris beach and about 5 minutes from Fig Tree Bay. 85 m² inside plus a 50 m² part-covered terrace with panoramic sea views, 2 bedrooms (one en suite), sold fully furnished, with private covered parking, a communal overflow pool and a gym. Reduced from €500,000 to €470,000.
